ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: French Orientalisms Since the story of Charlemagneøs campaign against the Saracens in Moorish Spain told in the Chanson de Roland, French literature has been populated with colorful figures of the Orient and Islam. In this course we will explore the imaginary Orient of French literature and the visual arts from the Middle Ages to the nineteenth century. We will encounter and examine Turks, Persans, Moors and other øorientalsø in texts of many different genres (novel, short story, poetry, tragedy, travel narrative) by Rabelais, Racine, Mme de Lafayette, Montesquieu, Voltaire, Hugo and others. Readings and class discussion in French.
